source_audit.scope: Deliberate focus targets, not every surface word in every passage.
source_audit.method: Extract official Goethe PDFs, normalize case, articles, punctuation, whitespace, and common inflection stems, then require every focus target to match the wordlist for its band.
limitations: A wordlist match supports lexical level placement but does not prove that every sentence or grammar explanation is error-free.
Goethe describes its wordlists as reference inventories rather than complete teaching sequences.
The ordering and spaced-repetition links are Nochmal curriculum decisions and are not presented as official CEFR requirements.
A qualified German-language teacher should review the corpus before it is marketed as a complete mastery course.
